answer: Your most recent HbA1c (the average blood sugar test) was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. Before that it was 7.1% in August 2025 and 7.6% in May 2025, so the trend has been downward. No HbA1c after February 2026 is in your records, so it is probably due for a check now.
